description: YHCrystal-2512 is a powdered, rigid waterproofing material specially formulated for direct integration into concrete during mixing process. Upon incorporation, it forms a monolithic structure with the concrete, enhancing its capability to resist high hydrostatic pressure. Additionally, the material enables self-repairs of cracks up to 0.4 mm in width, ensuring long-term durability and sustained waterproofing performance.
whereToUse: permanent anti-seepage and waterproofing of concrete structures including basements, tunnels
sewage treatment pools, water supply pools, sewers
elevator shafts, swimming pools, chemical plants, and other concrete structures
advantages: Maximizes the density of cement concrete itself.
This allows for simultaneous pouring and waterproofing in a single construction step
Exhibits excellent self-healing functionality, capable of automatically repairing micro-cracks in the concrete.
The self-healing mechanism is reactivated in the presence of water
It significantly improves the workability of concrete and enhances concrete strength by 20-30%.
Reduces the slump loss in freshly mixed concrete
Prevents corrosion caused by harmful chemical erosive media (such as chloride ions), thereby enhancing the long-term durability of the concrete.
notFor: Using this product requires a corresponding concrete mix ratio test.
Construction is not permitted in temperatures below 5 °C, or during rain or snow.
Protect the fresh mortar or concrete from exposure to sunlight, rain, strong winds and temperatures below 5 °C within 48 hours after application.

consumption.quote: The admixture amount is 1% to 2% of the cement or cementitious material, and the actual amount will be determined based on the actual project requirements.

mixing: Wet Mixing: First, mix the calculated amount of YHCrystal-2512 with 10% to 20% of the application water to form a slurry. Then, pour the cement, aggregate, sand, and 80% to 90% of the application water into the mixing truck. Finally, add the prepared YHCrystal-2512 slurry into the mixing truck for mixing.
storage: The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +40 °C. Protect from sunlight, rain, frost and humidity.
